messages:
Maya: Quick sync — need to lock DX priorities for the next quarter. We got three customer-driven asks and a few internal asks. Want to agree on scope/launch criteria and owners.

Maya: Customer asks (short):
- streaming token leak in python SDK (customer: Flowly)
- embedding quickstart + cache pattern (customer: Marketlytics)
- multi-model routing sample app with canary fallback (customer: Orion)

Arjun: I have a repro for the python streaming leak. Happens when you call .stream() + async context and yield drop. I can put a minimal test in repo. ETA: PR + unit test in 10 days.

Leah: For the quickstart, can we reuse the samplekit scaffolding instead of a full repo? customers want a single-click deploy and a small test harness. Prefer a 5-file minimal example + infra script.

Carlos: Multi-model routing sample is heavier — needs per-route routing policy, model variants, and a fallback path. Also asks for perf numbers (tokens/sec) for each variant. Might be a 3-sprint effort if we do infra + A/B hooks.

Sam: Platform note: to demo canary + fallback we need route-level metrics surfaced in the console (latency and cost per model). That work is in our backlog but not prioritized yet. Rough ETA if we reprioritize: ~3 weeks for an MVP metrics view.

Jen: FYI Atlassian asked for an enterprise quickstart with VPC notes and KMS integration. That changes docs + template variables. Should we treat that as a separate enterprise quickstart or extend the Marketlytics one?

Maya: Proposed prioritization (today):
1) SDK streaming fix — P0 (blocking an active customer)
2) Embedding quickstart (minimal + cache pattern) — P1, can ship as a single repo + GH template
3) Multi-model sample — P2 for full-featured; P1 for a lightweight demo without infra (just code + config)

Arjun: Agree on P0 for SDK. I'll add a checklist: repro, fix, tests, changelog entry, cut patch release.

Leah: For the embedding quickstart I'll draft a layout: README, quickstart CLI, one integration test that runs locally, and a pre-built Docker example. Can we include a short eval script to sanity-check quality?

Maya: Yes include eval script. Launch criteria for quickstart:
- README < 500 words with architecture diagram
- CLI to scaffold + run locally (one command)
- Automated test that verifies embedding/cache on CI
- One short how-to snippet for KMS/VPC steps (enterprise note)

Carlos: For the lightweight multi-model demo, propose we:
- implement client-side routing sample (no infra)
- include a JSON config with two model variants and a fallback order
- a script that runs a small A/B comparison and prints latency/cost estimates

Sam: Sounds good. I'll scope the console metrics work as an optional follow-up and provide an API hook so the sample app can push traces/logs.

Jen: For the Atlassian ask, recommend we make an "enterprise-options.md" supplement to the quickstart instead of branching templates. That keeps maintenance low.

doc-bot: New GH issue created: redwood/devex#817 — "python-sdk: streaming context memory leak (Flowly)"

Maya: Action items summary: 
- Arjun: P0 SDK fix — PR + tests (owner)
- Leah: Embeddings quickstart draft + CI tests (owner)
- Carlos: Multi-model lightweight demo prototype (owner)
- Sam: Provide API hook + ETA for console metrics (blocker for full sample)
- Jen: Draft enterprise-options.md and coordinate with security/compliance

Maya: Can everyone add time estimates in the tracking issue by EOD tomorrow? We'll triage in the roadmap meeting Friday. :thumbsup:

Arjun: Added reproduction steps and initial estimate (5 dev days).

Leah: Draft created in a branch, linking in the issue. ETA for first pass: 7 days.

Carlos: Prototype branch pushed with basic routing config, demo script. ETA to polish: 10 days.

Sam: I'll post the API contract for metrics by EOD Monday.

Jen: Starting enterprise doc draft now.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll turn this into a short PR to the roadmap doc and allocate the OKR tickets.

Leah: quick sidenote — can we add a short snippet to the quickstart showing how to set up prefix caching? small code block below is fine:

Leah: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# enable short-prefix cache
client.config.cache.enable_prefix_cache(max_prefix_tokens=64)
```

Arjun: looks good, maybe show TTL example too.

Maya: Closing thread for now — will reopen if scope changes.
